description: Small, water-soaked spots on leaves that turn dark brown to black. Spots may have a yellow halo. Often appears on older leaves first.
treatment: Remove infected leaves. Apply copper-based fungicide. Avoid overhead watering. Rotate crops.
follow_up_question: Do the spots have a yellow halo around them, and are they appearing on older leaves first?

description: Brown spots with concentric rings (target-like pattern) on lower leaves. Yellowing around spots. Progresses upward.
treatment: Remove affected leaves. Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb fungicide. Mulch to prevent soil splash.
follow_up_question: Do the spots have concentric rings that look like a target or bullseye pattern?

description: Large, irregular water-soaked lesions that turn brown and greasy. White fuzzy mold on undersides in humid conditions. Rapid spread.
treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately. Apply copper fungicide. Improve air circulation.
follow_up_question: Are the lesions large and irregular, with white fuzzy growth on the undersides of leaves?

description: Pale yellow spots on upper leaf surface. Olive-green to brown velvety mold on the underside. Common in high humidity.
treatment: Improve ventilation. Reduce humidity. Apply fungicide if severe. Remove affected leaves.
follow_up_question: Is there a velvety olive-green or brown mold visible on the underside of the leaves?

description: Small circular spots with dark borders and light gray centers. Tiny black dots (spore bodies) visible in the centers. Starts on lower leaves.
treatment: Remove infected leaves. Apply fungicide. Avoid overhead watering. Mulch around plants.
follow_up_question: Do the spots have light gray centers with tiny black dots inside them?

description: No visible signs of disease, pest damage, or nutrient deficiency. Leaves are uniform green with normal texture.
treatment: No treatment needed. Continue regular care and monitoring.
follow_up_question: Are the leaves uniformly green with no spots, lesions, or discoloration?
